His father noticed that Wolferl could remember quite a little of the music that Nannerl was practising.

arxiv-2106-04876.title: Recovering AES Keys with a Deep Cold Boot Attack
arxiv-2106-04876.creator: Itamar Zimerman, Eliya Nachmani, Lior Wolf
arxiv-2106-04876.description: Abstract Cold boot attacks inspect the corrupted random access memory soon after the power has been shut down. While most of the bits have been corrupted, many bits, at random locations, have not. Since the keys in many encryption schemes are being expanded in memory into longer keys with fixed redundancies, the keys can often be restored.

arxiv-2108-13056.title: Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz (QAOA) Phase Diagrams and Applications for Quantum Chemistry
arxiv-2108-13056.creator: Vladimir Kremenetski, Tad Hogg, Stuart Hadfield, Stephen J. Cotton, Norm M. Tubman
arxiv-2108-13056.description: Abstract We adapt the Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz (QAOA) to find ground states in quantum chemistry problems and empirically evaluate our protocol on several molecules. These simulations show robust qualitative behavior for QAOA as a function of the number of steps and size of the parameters.

arxiv-2204-00886.title: A general mathematical framework for constrained mixed-variable blackbox optimization problems with meta and categorical variables Thanks: GERAD and Department of Mathematics and Industrial Engineering, Polytechnique Montréal. This work is supported by the NSERC Alliance grant 544900-19 in collabora
arxiv-2204-00886.creator: Charles Audet, Edward Hallé-Hannan, Sébastien Le Digabel
arxiv-2204-00886.description: Abstract Abstract A mathematical framework for modelling constrained mixed-variable optimization problems is presented in a blackbox optimization context. The framework introduces a new notation and allows solution strategies. The notation framework allows meta and categorical variables to be explicitly and efficiently modelled, which facilitates the solution of such problems.

arxiv-2206-07962.title: Beam focus modifications by cropping partially coherent X-ray beams
arxiv-2206-07962.creator: Manuel Sanchez del Rio, Rafael Celestre, Juan Reyes-Herrera, Philipp Brumund, Marco Cammarata
arxiv-2206-07962.description: Abstract We simulate the focusing of a partially-coherent X-ray beam emitted by an undulator in a fourth-generation storage ring by performing a coherent mode decomposition and wave optics propagation. The focus position is shifted, and its size is enlarged when an entrance slit crops the beam.

arxiv-2212-12277.title: r r -Lah distribution: properties, limit theorems and an application to compressed sensing
arxiv-2212-12277.creator: Zakhar Kabluchko and David Albert Steigenberger
arxiv-2212-12277.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zakhar Kabluchko and David Albert Steigenberger. We introduce and study the r r -Lah distribution whose definition involves r r -Stirling numbers of both kinds. We compute its expectation and variance, show its log-concavity and prove limit theorems for this distribution. We use these results to prove threshold phenomena for convex cones generated by random walks and to analyze the probability of unique recovery of sparse monotone signals from linear measurements. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2304-06294.title: When do homomorphism counts help in query algorithms?
arxiv-2304-06294.creator: Balder ten Cate, Victor Dalmau, Phokion G. Kolaitis, Wei-Lin Wu
arxiv-2304-06294.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Balder ten Cate, Victor Dalmau, Phokion G. Kolaitis, Wei-Lin Wu. A query algorithm based on homomorphism counts is a procedure for determining whether a given instance satisfies a property by counting homomorphisms between the given instance and finitely many predetermined instances. In a left query algorithm, we count homomorphisms from the predetermined instances to the given instance, while in a right query algorithm we count homomorphisms from the given instance to the predetermined instances.

arxiv-2305-00954.title: Nearly Heisenberg-limited noise-unbiased frequency estimation by tailored sensor design
arxiv-2305-00954.creator: Francisco Riberi, Gerardo A. Paz-Silva, Lorenza Viola
arxiv-2305-00954.description: Abstract We consider entanglement-assisted frequency estimation by Ramsey interferometry, in the presence of dephasing noise from general spatiotemporally correlated environments. By working in the widely employed local estimation regime, we show that even for infinite measurement statistics, noise renders standard estimators biased or ill-defined.

arxiv-2305-08756.title: Complex conformal transformations and zero-rest-mass fields
arxiv-2305-08756.creator: Bernardo Araneda
arxiv-2305-08756.description: Abstract We give a simple prescription for relating different solutions to the zero-rest-mass field equations in conformally flat space-time via complex conformal transformations and changes in reality conditions. We give several examples including linearized black holes. In particular, we show that the linearized Plebański-Demiański and Schwarzschild fields are related by a complex translation and a complex special conformal transformation.

arxiv-2403-13076.title: Spatial Autoregressive Model on a Dirichlet Distribution
arxiv-2403-13076.creator: Teo Nguyen, Sarat Moka, Kerrie Mengersen, Benoit Liquet
arxiv-2403-13076.description: Abstract Abstract Compositional data find broad application across diverse fields, including ecology, geology, economics, and public health, due to their efficacy in representing proportions or percentages of various components within a whole. Spatial dependencies often exist in compositional data, particularly when the data represents different land uses or ecological variables.

arxiv-2407-11841.title: Asymptotic analysis of boundary layers for Stokes systems in periodic homogenization
arxiv-2407-11841.creator: Moustapha Agne 1
arxiv-2407-11841.description: Abstract . We investigate the asymptotics of boundary layers in periodic homogenization. The analysis is focused on a Stokes system with periodic coefficients and periodic Dirichlet data posed in the half-space { y ∈ ℝ d : y ⋅ n − s > 0 } \{y\in\mathbb{R}^{d}:y\cdot n-s>0\} .

arxiv-2410-21608.title: Anisotropic spin dynamics in antiferromagnets with a nonrelativistic spin splitting
arxiv-2410-21608.creator: Konstantin S. Denisov 1, Igor Žutić 1
arxiv-2410-21608.description: Abstract Antiferromagnets (AFM) with a nonrelativistic spin splitting (NSS) of electronic bands expand the range of spin-dependent phenomena and their applications. A crucial understanding for both of them pertains to the inherent spin dynamics. We demonstrate that the d d -wave NSS gives rise to extremely anisotropic spin dynamics of carriers driven by the relaxation induced by motional narrowing.

arxiv-2502-02661.title: The Conformal Primon Gas at the End of Time
arxiv-2502-02661.creator: Sean A. Hartnoll and Ming Yang
arxiv-2502-02661.description: Abstract The Belinksy-Khalatnikov-Lifshitz dynamics of gravity close to a spacelike singularity can be mapped, at each point in space separately, onto the motion of a particle bouncing within half the fundamental domain of the modular group. We show that the semiclassical quantisation of this motion is a conformal quantum mechanics where the states are constrained to be modular invariant.

arxiv-2502-19283.title: Quasi-reversible parametric instability in presence of noise
arxiv-2502-19283.creator: Marcel G. Clerc, Claudio Falcón, René G. Rojas
arxiv-2502-19283.description: Abstract We present an experimental and theoretical study of the effect of spatio-temporal fluctuations in quasi-reversible systems displaying a spatial quintic supercritical bifurcation. The saturation mechanism is drastically changed by the inclusion of fluctuations. Experimentally, we observe the modification of the bifurcation diagram of parametrically amplified surface waves as spatiotemporal fluctuations stemming from an underlying vortex flow are included.

arxiv-2602-11882.title: Where Bits Matter in World-Model Planning: A Paired Mixed-Bit Study for Efficient Spatial Reasoning
arxiv-2602-11882.creator: Suraj RanganathUniversity of California San Diego suranganath@ucsd.edu Anish PatnaikUniversity of California San Diego anpatnaik@ucsd.edu Vaishak MenonUniversity of California San Diego vamenon@ucsd.edu
arxiv-2602-11882.description: Abstract Efficient spatial reasoning requires world models that remain reliable under tight precision budgets. We study whether low-bit planning behavior is determined mostly by total bitwidth or by where bits are allocated across modules. Using DINO-WM on the Wall planning task, we run a paired-goal mixed-bit evaluation across uniform, mixed, asymmetric, and layerwise variants under two planner budgets.

pmc-11312977.creator: Zhixin Wu, Long He, Jiarui Hou, Guo Li, Jiale Ma
pmc-11312977.description: In the context of ecological sustainability, this study focuses on the effect of variables of pasture fibers on the thermal properties of slag bricks made from a green recyclable material. This experiment uses slag as the binder, sand as the aggregate, and pasture fiber as an additive.

pmc-11427402.title: The association between oxidative balance score and muscular dystrophies
pmc-11427402.creator: Dupeng Tang, Lanqing Lin, Yixin Zheng
pmc-11427402.description: IntroductionThis research utilized data from the NHANES 2011–2018 study to investigate the connection between the Oxidative Balance Score (OBS) and muscular dystrophies.MethodsThis study is a cross-sectional, observational, secondary analysis utilizing data from the NHANES 2011-2018. Spearman’s correlation, chi-square tests, logistic regression, and restricted cubic spline plots were employed for statistical analyses.

pmc-11603262.title: Assessment of MIR3142HG genetic polymorphisms and the susceptibility of lumbar disc herniation in the Chinese population
pmc-11603262.creator: Qi Dong, Guoxia Ren, Dingjun Hao
pmc-11603262.description: Lumbar disc herniation (LDH) is a common degenerative disease of the lumbar spine, which is related to host genetic factors. Our study aimed to explore the association between MIR3142HG polymorphisms and LDH susceptibility. Six SNPs in MIR3142HG from 504 LDH patients and 500 healthy individuals were genotyped by the Agena MassARRAY platform.

pmc-11658271.title: Infective endocarditis: Awareness, knowledge gaps and behaviours amongst adults with congenital heart disease
pmc-11658271.creator: S. Haider, K. Krishanthasan, I. Olakorede, A. Constantine, I. Rafiq, K. Dimopoulos
pmc-11658271.description: BackgroundAdults with congenital heart disease (ACHD) have an increased risk of infective endocarditis (IE), associated with significant morbidity and mortality. This risk is compounded by patient-related factors, including lack of awareness of IE and the presence of a learning disability (LD).

pmc-13445479.title: N-acetylated amino acids: An overlooked layer of metabolic regulation
pmc-13445479.creator: Dirk Weber, Achim Bub
pmc-13445479.description: N-acetylated amino acids (Ac-AAs) have been repeatedly reported in metabolomics studies of high-intensity exercise, cold-exposed brown adipose tissue (BAT), and various pathological conditions. Despite their recurrent detection, the origins and physiological functions of Ac-AAs remain poorly understood, and evidence is fragmented across diverse scientific disciplines.

pmc-13538292.title: From Gut to Mind: Impact of Probiotics on Depression, Anxiety, Mood, Gut Microbiota, Sleep and Stress—A Systematic Review of RCTs
pmc-13538292.creator: Monalisa Das, Nooruddin Thajuddin, Gangatharan Muralitharan, Megha Pundeer, Ramesh Ponnusamy, Ankita Mishra, Priyanka Nayak
pmc-13538292.description: BackgroundProbiotic supplementation may influence mental health through the gut–brain axis, with potential effects on depression, anxiety, sleep, cognition, stress hormones, and gut microbial composition. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the effects of probiotics on psychological, physiological, and gut microbiome-related outcomes across diverse populations.SummaryA comprehensive search of PubMed, MEDLINE, PsycINFO, and ScienceDirect identified randomized controlled trials evaluating probiotic supplementation.

pmc-13562848.title: Can the ‘Deathbed Etiquette’ guide support friends and family to navigate the dying process? A qualitative study examining the views of bereaved people
pmc-13562848.creator: Lara Datta Paulin, Louise Nelson, Katie Pears, Rhian Wyn Thomas, Sarah Clelland, Lesley Dunleavy, Margaret Doherty, Amy Gadoud
pmc-13562848.description: BackgroundHow people experience the death of a friend or relative is impacted by their knowledge of what to expect when someone is dying and how prepared they feel. Deathbed Etiquette is a written resource providing information about the dying process to support friends and relatives through this experience.ObjectiveTo explore the views of bereaved people on the guide Deathbed Etiquette.

pmc-13583922.title: A Germline BRCA2 Pathogenic Variant Identified by Multigene Panel Testing in Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma
pmc-13583922.creator: Kazuna Matsuo, Kenji Zennami, Mii Yoshida, Miki Hatakeyama, Maki Morikawa, Kyosuke Hattori, Shusuke Akamatsu
pmc-13583922.description: IntroductionUpper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC) is associated with Lynch syndrome; however, increasing evidence suggests broader genetic heterogeneity. Although multigene panel testing (MGPT) is increasingly adopted internationally, syndrome‐specific genetic testing (SSGT) remains predominant in Japan, potentially limiting detection of non‐Lynch hereditary variants. Appropriate selection for expanded germline evaluation remains challenging.
